history.overview: The Arena was built as a ritual combat chamber to break Dragorn morale and empower Muramite champions.

timeline.name: Arena Excavation
timeline.description: Dragorn prisoners were forced to carve the arena pit.

timeline.name: Champion Trials
timeline.description: Muramite champions began training and ritual combat trials.

timeline.name: Execution Era
timeline.description: The arena became the primary site for public executions.

timeline.name: Discord Ritual Integration
timeline.description: Inquisitors infused the arena with Discord wards.
